[[Image:Arran Head map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
'''Arran Head''' is the headland at the southeastern tip of [[Altara]]'s southern peninsula, at the opposite end of the peninsula to [[Ebou Dar]]. It marks the point where [[Kabal Deep]] opens out into the [[Sea of Storms]]. The [[Venir Mountains]] run from Arran Head along the peninsula almost to Ebou Dar.
